user.title: Set up KEMS
user.description: Choose the Home Assistant entities KEMS should observe. KEMS is read-only in this version.

data_description.current_import_rate: Octopus sensor containing the current import price.
data_description.next_import_rate: Octopus sensor containing the next import price.
data_description.off_peak: Octopus binary sensor that is on during off-peak periods.
data_description.intelligent_slot: Octopus binary sensor that is on during an Intelligent dispatch slot.
data_description.next_offpeak_start: Octopus timestamp sensor for the next off-peak start.
data_description.offpeak_end: Octopus timestamp sensor for the off-peak end.
data_description.ev_connected: Ohme binary sensor showing whether the vehicle is connected.
data_description.ev_charging: Ohme binary sensor showing whether charging is active.
data_description.ev_power: Ohme sensor showing charging power in kW.
data_description.ev_soc: Ohme sensor showing vehicle state of charge as a percentage.
